'''October 2001 Krakow tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Kraków, Poland in October 2001. [[Wojciech Wisniewski]] won it. It is known from Wojciech Wisniewski's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3068">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-21-krakow-poland-10-20-01d3068/ krakow-poland-10-20-01], DeckTech (Wojciech "Hipo" Wisniewski, 21 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-21-krakow-poland-10-20-01d3068/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' October 2001
* '''Site:''' Kraków, Poland
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 18
* '''Winner:''' [[Wojciech Wisniewski]]
